# Geyser Developer Platform

> Public SDK, CLI, emulator, contracts, and guides for durable framework-neutral agentic systems.

- [Start](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/)
- [Five-minute emulator quickstart](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/quickstart/)
- [Python SDK](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/sdk/)
- [CLI reference](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/cli/)
- [Durable runs](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/durable-runs/)
- [OpenAPI and schemas](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/reference/)
- [Compatibility status](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/compatibility/)
- [Security](https://docs.geyserlabs.ai/stable/security/)
- [Canonical source](https://github.com/geyserlabs/geyser-open)

Geyser Open is the reference runtime. Capability support is evidence-derived for an exact runtime,
provider, model profile, placement, and privacy posture. A source implementation, public package,
qualification receipt, production enablement, and observed deployment are separate facts.
